caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a metal spur with an attached leather strap. The leather strap is brown with three circular holes and visible stitching. The spur itself is metallic, rendered in shades of gray and silver, and consists of several distinct parts: a rounded, spiral-patterned ball where the metal meets the leather strap, a thick curved band forming the main part of the spur, and a series of three circular loops leading to the rowel. The rowel is a large, prominent, star-shaped wheel with eight spokes. The object is set against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or adornments.
title: Spur
